name: opencode-proxy
description: The OpenCode proxy layer (opencodeProfile) on top of the generic basekit proxy engine
author: intisy

scripts.build: npx tsc && npx esbuild src/frontdoor.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/frontdoor.mjs && npx esbuild src/front-door-plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/proxy --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/ir --external:@intisy-ai/anthropic-translator --outfile=dist/front-door-plugin.js && node scripts/postbuild-deploy.mjs
